method: Codex in-app Chromium, local HTTP server, first visible .event-card after reload; seven warm reload samples per state

baseline.description: Release 2 boundary before the Release 3 static-first loading changes

release2FreshOrigin.note: The first sample includes the initial service-worker and cold-origin cost.

release3FreshOrigin.note: Fresh default preferences render fewer cards than Release 2, so this is a first-card latency measure rather than a full-list throughput comparison.

release3Configured.note: Configured state exercises the long feed and remains below the separate configured-feed target.
